text:
To Whom It May Concern,  

I have worked closely with Ilya Fedorov as his direct manager at NexaPay Solutions, where he served as Senior Tech Lead. Over the past three years, he played a pivotal role in scaling our infrastructure and leading high-performing engineering teams. His ability to balance technical rigor with strategic vision has been instrumental in driving our fintech initiatives forward.  

Ilya’s strengths lie in system design, team leadership, and stakeholder alignment. He consistently delivers robust technical solutions that address complex business challenges. For example, he spearheaded the redesign of our payment processing architecture, reducing latency by 40% without compromising security. His leadership during a critical migration to a microservices model ensured minimal downtime and seamless integration across teams.  

Beyond technical expertise, Ilya excels in fostering collaboration. He regularly bridges gaps between engineering and product teams, ensuring shared understanding of priorities. His mentorship has elevated junior engineers’ capabilities, and his project management approach—rooted in Agile principles—keeps teams focused and adaptable.  

Ilya’s work ethic is defined by reliability and curiosity. He approaches problems with methodical precision and communicates outcomes clearly, even under pressure. His contributions have not only strengthened our technical foundation but also reinforced a culture of accountability and innovation.  

I wholeheartedly recommend Ilya for any opportunity where technical excellence and leadership are paramount.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]  
Senior Vice President of Engineering, NexaPay Solutions
